label: S3: List Objects
description: List an S3-compatible bucket's objects under a prefix, one page at a time: keys, sizes, last-modified times. A page holds at most `maxKeys` objects after `startAfter`, and no more than fit the 100 KB a wire carries; to read the next page, wire `lastKey` into the next call's `startAfter`, while `hasMore` is true.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The object store access (wire an S3Access node).

inputs.name: prefix
inputs.label: Prefix
inputs.description: Only keys starting with this; empty lists the whole bucket.

inputs.name: startAfter
inputs.label: Start after
inputs.description: List only the keys that come after this one. Empty starts at the first key. To read the next page, wire the previous call's `lastKey` here.

inputs.name: maxKeys
inputs.label: Max keys
inputs.description: The most objects one page holds (S3 lists at most 1000 at once). A page also stops early when more objects would weigh more than the 100 KB a wire carries.

outputs.name: objects
outputs.type: List[{ key: String, sizeBytes: Number, lastModified: String }]
outputs.description: This page's objects, in key order. Each object: key, sizeBytes, lastModified.

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: How many objects this page holds.

outputs.name: lastKey
outputs.description: The last key of this page (the `startAfter` it was given when the page is empty): wire it into the next call's `startAfter`.

outputs.name: hasMore
outputs.description: True when keys past this page match the prefix.

then.message: S3ListObjects '{id}': `bucket` is empty, `.` or `..`, which no URL can address; name a real bucket.
